title: The Shepherd's Boy and the Wolf
author: Aesop (adapted by J. H. Stickney)
summary: 牧童屡次谎报狼来了，等狼真的来了，再没人相信他。
publicDomainBasis: Aesop's fables are ancient; this retelling by J. H. Stickney was published in 1915. Published before 1923 and therefore public domain in the United States; Project Gutenberg releases it as public domain.

paragraphs.en: A MAN who had a fine flock of Sheep put them all into a field, and hired a Boy to take care of them, while he worked near by with his Men.
paragraphs.zh: 有个人有一大群羊，他把羊全都赶到一片地里，雇了一个男孩照看，自己带着雇工在附近干活。

paragraphs.en: The Sheep went nibbling the grass all day, up and down the hills and along the brook; and all that the Boy had to do was to look out for the Wolf, and see that he did not come prowling into the field.
paragraphs.zh: 羊整天在山坡上、小溪边啃草，男孩要做的只是留意狼，别让狼溜进地里来。

paragraphs.en: After a while the Boy began to wish that something would happen, it was so tiresome staying there all alone, with no one to speak to and nothing to do. He wished he could be with the Men in the next field, or that they could come and stay with him. All at once he thought to himself, “I will make them think the Wolf has come. That will be great fun.”
paragraphs.zh: 过了一会儿，男孩开始希望出点什么事，因为一个人待在那里，没人说话，又没事可做，实在太无聊了。他盼着能跟隔壁地里的雇工们待在一起，或者他们能过来陪陪他。忽然他心生一计：“我要让他们以为狼来了。那一定很好玩。”

paragraphs.en: So he called out as loudly as he could, “Help! help! The Wolf!” and all the Men came running up.
paragraphs.zh: 于是他扯开嗓子大喊：“救命！救命！狼来了！”所有的雇工都跑了过来。

paragraphs.en: When they found it was only a joke, they laughed, and went back to their work.
paragraphs.zh: 他们发现只是个玩笑，笑了笑，就回去干活了。

paragraphs.en: On the next day the Boy tried the same trick again. As before, the Men dropped their mattocks and spades, for fear there might be danger, and ran to the help of the Boy. He only laughed at them for their pains, and this time they did not relish the joke. Still the Boy did not give it up. Again he shouted “Wolf! Wolf!” till the Men took no notice of him when he called them, no matter how loudly or how long he shouted.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天，男孩又耍了同样的把戏。和上次一样，雇工们怕真有危险，扔下锄头铁锹，跑来救他。他却只是嘲笑他们白忙一场，这一次他们可不喜欢这个玩笑了。可男孩仍不肯罢休。他又喊“狼来了！狼来了！”喊到后来，不管他叫得多大声、叫多久，雇工们都不理他了。

paragraphs.en: After a while, the Wolf did get into the field. Then in real terror the Boy called and called: “Pray do come and help me. The Wolf is killing the sheep. The Wolf! the Wolf!” But no one gave heed to his cries. Finding only a terrified coward in care of the flock, the Wolf left few of them uninjured.
paragraphs.zh: 过了不久，狼真的闯进了地里。男孩这才真正害怕起来，一遍又一遍地喊：“求求你们来帮帮我！狼在咬羊了！狼！狼！”可是没有人理会他的呼喊。狼发现看羊的只是个吓坏了的胆小鬼，便把羊咬得所剩无几。
